subtopic: Euler Form, De Moivre's Theorem & Roots of a Complex Number
title: Factorization identities using omega

board_content.text: These come from splitting a real polynomial into its complex linear factors.
Heavily used in JEE Advanced algebra — memorize the cubic-sum one.

segments_english.text: Because omega and omega squared are the non-trivial cube roots, they factor several standard expressions into neat products.
First, a squared plus a b plus b squared factors as a minus b omega, times a minus b omega squared.
Flip the middle sign and you get a squared minus a b plus b squared equals a plus b omega, times a plus b omega squared.
The sum of two cubes gets a full factorization: a cubed plus b cubed equals a plus b, times a plus b omega, times a plus b omega squared.
Similarly the difference of two cubes: a cubed minus b cubed equals a minus b, times a minus b omega, times a minus b omega squared.

And the star identity, worth memorizing outright: a cubed plus b cubed plus c cubed minus three a b c factors as a plus b plus c, times a plus b omega plus c omega squared, times a plus b omega squared plus c omega.
All of these arise for the same reason: a real polynomial is being split into its complex linear factors, and omega supplies exactly the right roots to do it.
These show up heavily in JEE Advanced algebra. The cubic-sum identity in particular is one you should have instantly at your fingertips.

segments_hinglish.text: Kyunki omega aur omega squared non-trivial cube roots hain, wo kai standard expressions ko neat products mein factor karte hain.
Pehle, a squared plus a b plus b squared factor hota hai a minus b omega, times a minus b omega squared.
Beech ka sign flip karo aur milta hai a squared minus a b plus b squared barabar a plus b omega, times a plus b omega squared.
Sum of two cubes ko full factorization milti hai: a cubed plus b cubed barabar a plus b, times a plus b omega, times a plus b omega squared.
Waise hi difference of two cubes: a cubed minus b cubed barabar a minus b, times a minus b omega, times a minus b omega squared.

Aur star identity, seedhe yaad karne layak: a cubed plus b cubed plus c cubed minus three a b c factor hota hai a plus b plus c, times a plus b omega plus c omega squared, times a plus b omega squared plus c omega.
Ye sab ek hi wajah se aate hain: ek real polynomial apne complex linear factors mein split ho raha hai, aur omega bilkul sahi roots deta hai ye karne ke liye.
Ye JEE Advanced algebra mein bahut aate hain. Cubic-sum identity khaas taur par aapke fingertips par turant honi chahiye.
